title: renderer.ts project-close comment points at CLAUDE.md instead of keys-decision-2
notes: src/renderer/renderer.ts:678 says Ctrl+Q is listed on the manager's board, command and notes screens though it does nothing there, and that 'CLAUDE.md's help section says why'. CLAUDE.md's help rule (keys-rule-2) never said why; keys-decision-2 in docs/keys/decisions.md does. Cost: someone wondering whether the dead key in Ctrl+H is a bug finds no reason in CLAUDE.md and 'fixes' the help, undoing a settled decision. Point the comment at keys-decision-2. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/286 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/285
